name: JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd.
summary: JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd. operates in the electronics and graphics businesses in Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, and internationally. The company operates through Electronics Related Business, Graphics Solutions Business, and Solar Power Generation Business segments. The company develops, manufactures, and sells gas supply equipment for semiconductor and LCD manufacturing; total facility and gas management, and maintenance services; and designs and constructs piping for special gas and chemicals, ultrapure water, vacuum, and general equipment, as well as sells gas, vision systems, and advanced driver assistance systems.
